Its pages say "פטור מדמי משמרת" (library f57d393657c2d282, meitav.co.il/trade/independent_trading) and "ללא דמי משמרת ועמלות נסתרות" (library 697ecc32a2bdcfa4, meitav.co.il/trade), and neither says under which conditions.
